2607.17689.title: Tokenizing Crosslingual Homographs
2607.17689.paper_summary: Multilingual language models rely on shared subword vocabularies to represent multiple languages within a limited number of token units. While such sharing is often useful, it can also create cases in which identical surface forms are treated too uniformly across languages, even when their meanings or usage differ. We investigate this limitation through cross-lingual homographs and false friends, and examine whether introducing language information earlier in the tokenization process can improve their treatment. We propose a simple tokenizer-level intervention based on language cues: language-specific characters replacing initial characters of shared-vocabulary words, reducing common identity during vocabulary construction. In intrinsic analysis, we find through tokenizer-level statistics that BPE and UnigramLM often treat cross-lingual homographs in a largely language agnostic way, whereas the context-sensitive SaGe tokenizer diverges more strongly; our intervention removes this gap. In downstream English-to-X machine translation, our cues yield modest improvements in several settings, especially under BPE, although the effect is not consistent across all languages and evaluation sets. Overall, the findings suggest that adding lightweight language information at the tokenizer level is a promising direction for further exploration.
2607.17689.paper_summary_zh: 多語言模型依賴共享的子詞詞彙來在有限的標記單位內表示多種語言。雖然這種共享通常是有用的，但它也可能造成相同表面形式在不同語言中被過於統一地處理，即使它們的含義或用法有所不同。我們通過跨語言同形異義詞和假朋友來調查這一限制，並檢視在標記化過程中早期引入語言信息是否能改善它們的處理。我們提出了一種基於語言線索的簡單標記器級干預：用特定語言的字符替換共享詞彙單詞的首字符，減少在詞彙構建過程中的共同身份。在內部分析中，我們通過標記器級統計發現，BPE和UnigramLM通常以較為語言無關的方式處理跨語言同形異義詞，而上下文敏感的SaGe標記器則更強烈地發散；我們的干預消除了這一差距。在下游的英語到X機器翻譯中，我們的線索在幾個設置中產生了適度的改善，特別是在BPE下，儘管這一效果在所有語言和評估集上並不一致。總體而言，研究結果表明，在標記器級別添加輕量級語言信息是一個值得進一步探索的有前景方向。
2607.17689.author: Rotem Brillant et.al.
